name: Sentinel Sensor Container Stopped, Killed, or Removed
description: Detects the docker CLI being used to stop, kill, or remove one of this project's own Linux telemetry sensor containers (auditbeat, Suricata, Zeek) — the actual defense-impairment path in this environment, since auditbeat runs as a Docker container talking directly to the kernel audit interface rather than as a native auditd service (there is no auditctl binary or systemd auditd unit on this host to target). Linux analog of the Defender-disabled rule, retargeted to how this specific sensor is actually deployed rather than the generic auditctl/systemctl form. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_sensor_container_stopped.yml, hand-converted from Sigma (no ecs_linux/auditd pysigma pipeline exists, so this EQL targets the real auditbeat auditd-module field shape directly). Originally written against auditctl/systemctl before live-testing found neither exists on this host; rewritten to match the real architecture, see docs/build-log.md.
query: any where process.executable like~ "*/docker" and process.title like~ ("*stop*", "*kill*", "*rm*") and process.title like~ ("*sentinel-auditbeat*", "*sentinel-suricata*", "*sentinel-zeek*")
false_positives: Legitimate maintenance (a compose redeploy, a manual sensor restart) stopping the container intentionally
author: Sentinel
